author: sunnyasquabla
body:
#### PR description:

Adds a filter ID to the NGT/Phase-2 HLT NanoAOD trigger-object table (`TrigObjP4FlatTableProducer`).

Objects passing the filters listed in `extraFilters` were already added to the `TriggerObject` table, but there was no way to tell which of those filters an object had passed. With this PR each object gets a `uint64` column `TriggerObject_filterBits`: bit `i` is set if the object passed `extraFilters[i]`. For more than 64 filters, further columns `filterBits1`, `filterBits2`, ... are added. The bit -> filter map is written in the column description, so the file documents itself.

- `extraFilters` is empty by default, so **no change to the default output**: no new columns are created.
- `hltTriggerObjects_cff.py`: updated the comment on `extraFilters`, which said that no extra column is added.
- Unit test `testNanohltDQM.sh`: now sets one extra filter and checks that `TriggerObject_filterBits` is written with the right description.

This allows step-by-step (per-filter) HLT efficiencies directly from the NanoAOD.

#### PR validation:

- `scram b code-checks`, `scram b code-format` and `scram b runtests` (`testProduceNanoHLT`) pass in CMSSW_20_1_0_pre5.
- With empty `extraFilters`, the `TriggerObject` content is identical to the output without this PR (compared event by event).
- 9000 TTbar PU200 events (`HLT:@relvalRun4`, `NANO:@Phase2HLT`), produced with 0, 26 (`HLT_IsoMu24_FromL1TkMuon` + `HLT_Ele32_WPTight_Unseeded` filters) and 237 (all object-saving filters of all `HLT_*` paths) extra filters:
  - step-by-step plateau efficiencies for `HLT_IsoMu24_FromL1TkMuon` and `HLT_Ele32_WPTight_Unseeded` are identical with 26 and 237 filters;
  - cost (median per event):

    | extraFilters | 0 | 26 | 237 |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | trigger objects / event | 2.5 | 3.6 | 63.7 |
    | `hltTriggerObjP4Table` CPU [ms] | 3.7 | 7.4 | 28.6 |
    | NanoAOD file size [kB] | 132.6 | 132.6 | 133.5 |

    With all 237 filters the module costs ~25 ms/event more (~0.1% of the ~22 s/event job) and the file grows by ~0.7%.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Not a backport.
title: [NGT] TrigObjP4FlatTableProducer: add filterBits for extraFilters
